Independent review finds the city library network needs reform

Published 1 March 2026

Section 1. The independent review published its findings this week, finding that the current framework is not fully delivering on its statutory objectives. Branches open for fewer hours than the plan requires, the catalogue is split between three systems, and readers wait weeks for books held at another branch. The reviewers propose a single catalogue, a common schedule and a fund for repairs.
